newsitem.title: CHINA: China sends Yeltsin message for speedy recovery.
newsitem.headline: China sends Yeltsin message for speedy recovery.

text.p: China's President Jiang Zemin has sent a message to Russian President Boris Yeltsin, wishing him a speedy recovery after his heart bypass operation, the official People's Daily said on Wednesday.
"Jiang Zemin...wished Yeltsin an early recovery," the newspaper said.

"In his cable, Jiang Zemin also said he was looking forward to meeting Yeltsin again to push forward the development of Sino-Russian ties for the benefit of the people of the two countries and for world peace and stability," the newspaper said without elaborating.

Yeltsin had recovered consciousness by early Tuesday evening after a quintuple heart bypass operation. Surgeons said the operation was a complete success and a routine convalescence was expected for the 65-year-old patient.
